newsitem.title: USA: Southern Mineral starts two new wells.
newsitem.headline: Southern Mineral starts two new wells.

text.p: Southern Mineral Corp said in Wednesday it had completed, tested and begun production from two wells in Louisiana and Texas acquired with the August 30 purchase of the SMC Development L.P.

The Dawson Heirs No. 1 well in Louisiana was put on production on September 11, and was producing at a rate of 1,548 thousand cubic feet of gas and 12 barrels of condensate per day, the company said in a statement.
The Ocker Trust No. 1 well began production on September 12, at a rate of 532,000 cubic feet of natural gas and 13 barrels of condensate per day, Southern Mineral said.
It had tested 700,000 cubic feet and 15 barrels of condensate per the day, the company said.
Dawson Heirs No. 1 tested 1,470,000 cubic feet of gas and seven barrels of condenstate per day, it said.
Southern Mineral said it had a 93 percent working interest in each well, both operated by Diasu Oil & Gas Co.
Dawson Heirs is located in the South Bourg field in Terrebone Parish, Louisianna and Ocker Trust is located in the Lake Bourgentine field in Aransas County, Texas, it said.
